session_summary: Phase 10 bug sprint: fixed 5 production bugs. (1) Server VesselPosition now emits sog+cog — root cause of dead stats and broken dead reckoning. (2) Dead reckoning now uses COG direction + sog speed; vessels glide between AIS pings instead of freezing. (3) localStorage cache pre-populates vessels on cold load. (4) Mobile bottom sheet uses React.createPortal to escape overflow:hidden grid ancestor. (5) Researcher identified Ongiara (MMSI 316045066) as the missing 5th ferry via MarineTraffic. QA passed all 3 gates with one minor ESLint fix (.claude/worktrees/ noise). bd stats: 4/4 closed, 0 blocked. PR #10 raised.
overall_notes: Docker containers consistently produce 0-byte logs during the ~90s auth period, then flush everything at completion. This is expected behavior — do not mistake silence for failure. The T4 portal agent was fastest (2min) because it touched only one file. Researcher was slowest (5min) due to web search API calls. Pattern: start parallel, poll patiently, push from host after each container exits Dead.
